label: description only, not proven
rounding: display only: every number rounded to 4 significant digits; the statistics in tr016_summary.json were computed on unrounded values

sources.polymarket: Polymarket public trade data (TR-013/TR-014 downloads, read-only; Envio export on Hugging Face for trades up to 12 Nov 2023, third-party, CC-BY-4.0); US inflation family from the Polymarket Gamma API and public trade feed (TR-016 download)

assets.bitcoin: Yahoo Finance public chart, BTC-USD daily
assets.gold: Yahoo Finance public chart, GLD daily (a fund, so no futures rolls)
assets.inflation_expectation_10y: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), T10YIE
assets.inflation_expectation_5y: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), T5YIE
assets.oil: FRED, DCOILWTICO (Energy Information Administration spot price; no futures rolls)
assets.us_10y_yield: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), DGS10
assets.us_2y_yield: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), DGS2
assets.us_3m_bill: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), DTB3
assets.usd_ils: Bank of Israel public data, representative rate RER_USD_ILS
assets.usd_jpy: FRED, DEXJPUS (noon New York buying rate)

notes: Odds series are on each asset's own trading calendar: the odds change is measured between two closes of that asset, so the same event family has a slightly different daily series for each asset.
No odds value is given after the family hold-back boundary.

TR-016 has no single odds level line: the family odds change sums several markets of the current event and the event switches over time. A chart line must be drawn from the daily changes (for example bars, or a running total labelled as such).

Large-move days: TR-016 has no separate large-move rule. What it marks are independent episodes (first day of each) and busy-trading runs (TR-014 rule). Lead rows use the same daily series shifted by 1 day or summed over 5 trading days.

bitcoin.source: Yahoo Finance public chart, BTC-USD daily
bitcoin.close_time: daily close at 00:00 UTC (end of the UTC day)
bitcoin.level_note: closing value (percent-move assets: price; basis-point assets: yield/rate in percent)
bitcoin.move_note: daily percent change between this close and the previous one
bitcoin.size_scaled_note: size of the daily move, either direction, divided by its median over the previous 60 trading days (used by size rows)
